pyTypeHintContexts.description:
Block of python source code that provides context for python type hints. For instance, if the following method
exists in `PySource: def foo(self, x: X)` and typeHintContext contains the definition
of `X` (e.g. `X = Union[str, int]`), we can use the definition of `X` from typeHintContext to properly type
argument `x` in `foo`

Only top-level {@link PyAst.Expr} are considered when using a typeHintContext. Resolved
ValueTypes are added to the `customTypeHints` map.

ignoreAllDefaultValues.description: If True, ignores all generated default values

_abstract.description: Indicates whether the generated type should be abstract

typeNameDefault.description: Name of the type we are generating. will default to the python class name if null

mixins.description: Names of types to mixin to created type

returnOverload.description: Map of method names to ValueTypes. Will overwrite method names to have the specified ValueType

paramOverload.description:
Map of parameter names to ValueTypes. All parameters with a matching name will have the specified ValueType.
{@link #paramOverloadsForMethod} takes priority over this method

annotation.description: Map of method names to Annotations to be applied to that method

privateMethods.description: set of method names to be declared private on the generated type

paramOverloadsForMethod.description:
Map of method names to a Map of Strings to ValueTypes. Allows you to manually set parameter type hints
for specific methods. This method of setting type hints takes priority over the paramOverload method

paramsForMethod.description:
Map of method names to a list of pairs containing the parameter name and its value type. The parameters will
be generated in the same order as they appear in this list. This takes precedence over inferred parameter types.

currentMethodName.description: The name of the current method being generated. Used to resolve paramOverloadsForMethod

customTypeHintsDefaults.description:
Map of strings to ValueTypes used to resolve python type hints for method parameters.
Useful for when you want to map specific python classes to c3 types

ignorePrivateMethods.description:
If true, ignore private python methods (method names prefixed with "_") and aren't
double underscore methods

methodsToSkip.description: Skip the generation of any methods whose names are in this set

ignoreDoubleUnderscoreMethods.description:
If true, ignore python methods prefixed and suffixed with a double underscore,
e.g. `__init__`

methodParameter.description: Indicates whether or not the spec is for a method parameter

pyMethodType.description: Indicates whether the spec is for a member method

preservesEmptyModifierOverride.description: ValueType modifier for value types that would normally be set to `PRESERVES_EMPTY`

nonOptionalParamModifierOverride.description: ValueType modifier for value types that would normally be set to `NON_OPTIONAL_PARAM`

defaultValueMap.description:
Map of strings to any used to set the default value of parameters where the python default value is a
{@link PyAst.Attribute} or {@link PyAst.Name}

defaultValueOverrideForMethod.description:
Map of method names to a Map of Strings to any. Allows you to manually set default values
for specific methods. This method of setting type hints takes priority over the defaultValueMap field

skipDefaultValuesForMethod.description: Set of method names for which we want to skip default value generation

declaredVars.description: {@link VarReferenceType}s to add to generated Type

pkgDefault.description: Pkg to assign to the new TypeMetas, will use the default pkg if not specified

declaredPrivate.description: Whether or not the c3typ should be considered private or not
